# iaas_microvm_mcp_server (Resource)

Manages an account MCP server used by sandbox gateways. OAuth sign-in remains a separate, person-bound browser action. Identity edits and deletion are refused while active sandbox bindings exist. Requires OpenTofu 1.11 or newer (write-only arguments); static tokens never enter state and are never returned by the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "mcp_bearer_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "iaas_microvm_mcp_server" "tools" {
  provider_slug        = "custom"
  name                 = "tools"
  label                = "Team tools"
  url                  = "https://tools.example.com/mcp"
  auth_kind            = "bearer"
  enabled              = true
  static_token         = var.mcp_bearer_token
  static_token_version = 1 # Increment to rotate without changing the revision.
  headers              = {}
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) Display label.
- `name` (String) Unique account key used in agent configuration. Immutable.
- `provider_slug` (String) Catalog slug or custom. Immutable.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `auth_kind` (String) oauth (default), bearer, or none (custom only).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the server is enabled. Default true. Disabling invalidates bindings.
- `headers` (Map of String) Nonsecret custom endpoint headers. At most 8, values at most 1024 bytes. Credential headers are refused. Set {} to clear.
- `static_token` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Bearer token, required for bearer creation, switching into bearer, or token rotation. Never stored in state or returned. Increment static_token_version to rotate.
- `static_token_version` (Number) Nonsecret rotation trigger, default 1. Increment to call rotate-token without changing server identity.
- `url` (String) Custom HTTPS endpoint; required for custom, resolved from catalog otherwise. Preserve path, query and trailing slash.

### Read-Only

- `credential_state` (String) Credential availability for this API token's acting person. Does not prove gateway readiness.
- `id` (String) Server UUID. Import by UUID.
- `resource` (String) OAuth resource resolved by the server; not a writable API field.
- `revision_id` (String) Current immutable destination revision UUID.
- `revision_number` (Number) Current destination revision number.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import does not recover tokens or perform OAuth sign-in.
terraform import iaas_microvm_mcp_server.tools 6b0c2a51-0e1f-4d1c-9a47-2f7f0b6d9c11
```
